title: A reordered coordinate construction restricts to affine reindexing on each standard chart
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\beta,\gamma$ be types and $b:\gamma\simeq\beta$ an equivalence. Let $\phi:\mathbb P(\beta;S)\to\mathbb P(\gamma;S)$ [def-pc-proj] be homOfIsFreeGenerator formed from the identity pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] of the coordinate sections $T_{b(j)}$ of $\mathcal O(1)$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist], on the opens $U_j=D_+(T_{b(j)})$. For every $i\in\gamma$, $k\in\beta$ and equality $b(i)=k$, the composite $U_k\hookrightarrow\mathbb P(\beta;S)\xrightarrow{\phi}\mathbb P(\gamma;S)$ equals the source standard-chart isomorphism, followed by affine reindexing induced by $\{j\in\gamma:j\ne i\}\to\{j\in\beta:j\ne k\}$, $j\mapsto b(j)$, followed by the inverse target standard-chart isomorphism and its open inclusion. There are no finiteness, nonemptiness or affineness assumptions.

source.place: Constructions Definition 01NF and Lemma 01NE: projective-space charts and coordinate construction, applied to bijective renaming and its inverse.

proof.text: For any family of global functions generating the unit ideal with its i-th entry equal to one, the native homOfSections_resLE_standardOpenIso_hom factors homOfSections as homOfVector followed by the inverse chart isomorphism and the chart inclusion. The basic open of the i-th function is the top open, whose inclusion is invertible; the quotient functions are the original functions, by eq_divBasicOpen. Equality of the affine maps follows from their base maps and coordinates via AffineSpace.hom_ext. This proves the private normalized_homOfSections helper.

Apply this normalized rule to the family on affine space having entry one at i and each other entry equal to its affine coordinate. The associated homOfVector is the identity by AffineSpace.hom_ext. Thus homOfSections is the inverse chart inclusion. homOfSections_appLE_coordRatio now computes the pullback of each projective coordinate ratio by the inverse chart. Apply the forward chart map to this equality and cancel its inverse, obtaining that the forward chart sends each affine coordinate to the corresponding ratio. This proves the private chart_coord helper for arbitrary base S.

On the source chart, the transition formula pullbackSection_twistOneSection_map_eq_smul for the identity gives s_j = coordRatio(b i,b j) times s_i. The free generator coefficient uniqueness (coeff_eq_iff) gives sectionRatio i j = coordRatio(b i,b j). The native ι_homOfIsFreeGenerator identifies the restriction with localHom. Apply the normalized factorization from step 1 to localHom, whose ith function is one. Its affine factor equals the source chart followed by reindexing: their base maps agree, and all coordinates agree by the ratio calculation and step 2. AffineSpace.hom_ext proves that equality, and postcomposition with the inverse target chart and inclusion proves the statement.

theorem ι_homOfIsFreeGenerator_reindex (β γ : Type u) (b : γ ≃ β)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    let s : γ → Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (𝟙 ℙ(β; S))).obj (twist β S 1), ⊤) :=
    fun j : γ ↦ Scheme.Modules.pullbackSection (𝟙 ℙ(β; S))
      (twistOneSection β S (b j))
    let U := fun j : γ ↦ standardOpen β S (b j)
    let hs := fun j : γ ↦
      isFreeGenerator_pullbackSection_twistOneSection (𝟙 ℙ(β; S)) (b j)
    let hU : ⨆ j, U j = ⊤ := (b.iSup_comp).trans (iSup_standardOpen β S)
    ∀ (i : γ) (k : β) (h : b i = k), (standardOpen β S k).ι ≫
      homOfIsFreeGenerator s U hs (ℙ(β; S) ↘ S) hU =
        (standardOpenIso β S k).hom ≫
          AffineSpace.reindex
            (fun j : {j : γ // j ≠ i} ↦
              (⟨b j.1, fun he ↦ j.2 (b.injective (he.trans h.symm))⟩ : {j : β // j ≠ k})) S ≫
          (standardOpenIso γ S i).inv ≫ (standardOpen γ S i).ι
